calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became the checked radio and received visible focus. The heading and description changed to Flood and Blue backlight; the stage changed to a blue glow behind an outlined figure.

A-1440.edge_observation: ArrowLeft selected Static with visible focus; the stage changed to a white diagonal beam and long shadow. Tab moved focus out of the document, while the dark selected segment and Static heading remained visible.
A-1440.fact_check: Flood and Blue backlight, and Static and Hard white side light, match the visible scenes. The stage is an illustration, so its physical accuracy is not established.
A-1440.strength: The large stage and immediate radio selection make the lighting differences easy to compare.
A-1440.weakness: The selected radio's small colored dot is less distinct than the filled segment, and the stage illustration provides no textual description in the inspected accessibility tree.
A-1440.repair: Add a cue-specific accessible description of the stage and strengthen the checked marker independently of color.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became checked and visibly focused; its name and Blue backlight appeared below a blue-lit figure.

A-390.edge_observation: ArrowLeft selected Static and showed a white side beam and shadow. After Tab moved focus out of the document, Static remained identifiable through its filled segment and heading.
A-390.fact_check: Both requested cue names and descriptions appeared and the rendered lighting changed accordingly. Physical lighting accuracy was not tested.
A-390.strength: The stage, three controls, and cue description fit together in the narrow viewport.
A-390.weakness: The illustrated stage has no textual description in the inspected accessibility tree.
A-390.repair: Provide a cue-specific accessible stage description while retaining the compact control layout.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and visibly focused, with the Flood heading and Blue backlight description. The stage transitioned from amber to a blue silhouette with a forward shadow.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; its name and Hard white side light appeared, and the settled scene showed a beam from the right and a shadow to the left. A further Shift+Tab focused Dusk while Static remained visibly filled and pressed.
B-1440.fact_check: The cue text and accessible image descriptions agree with the settled rendered scenes. The immediate after capture caught the transition before the blue scene settled; the settled capture confirms the final state. Physical lighting accuracy was not tested.
B-1440.strength: The theatrical typography, curtain, floor perspective, and distinct light paths form a cohesive stage presentation.
B-1440.weakness: During the transition, the new cue label appears before the stage has visually settled, briefly presenting a mixed scene.
B-1440.repair: Shorten or clarify the transition so the cue label and lighting state are easier to associate immediately.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and visibly focused; its name and description appeared, and the stage settled into a blue backlit silhouette with a forward shadow.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static. After another Shift+Tab, Dusk had the focus outline while Static remained filled and its name and hard white side light description remained visible. The settled stage showed the side beam and leftward shadow.
B-390.fact_check: The requested names and descriptions match the settled scenes and accessible image text. The immediate after capture shows an in-progress transition; physical lighting accuracy was not tested.
B-390.strength: The tall stage composition, cue text, and all three controls remain visible together at 390 CSS pixels.
B-390.weakness: The label updates before the transition finishes, briefly leaving the previous lighting visible under the new cue name.
B-390.repair: Make the transition faster or otherwise signal that the lighting preview is changing.

preference.reason: B gives the stage a stronger theatrical identity and makes the direction of light and resulting shadows especially legible. Its selected state remains distinct from keyboard focus, and the stage has cue-specific accessible descriptions. Both views completed the requested keyboard task; B's transition timing is its main observed weakness.

decision: The new performer did not retain the prior lighting clarity and lacked cue-specific accessible descriptions. Preserve round 4 and test a smaller repair against it.
